trajectory.curveLabel: Live plot of the raw shaky trajectory and the smoothed trajectory

desc.awb: Color cast: the light source is estimated and temperature corrected, re-aligning the three channels.
desc.lowlight: Low light: the histogram sits far left with heavy noise. Enhancement restores both highlights and shadows.
desc.hdr: High contrast: highlights and shadows are clipped. HDR recovery spreads both ends back out.
desc.sr: Low resolution: edges and textures are soft. Super-resolution rebuilds the detail.
desc.match: Multi-camera: this angle doesn't match the reference. Matching brings it to one look.
